events.summary:
SVRGID

The National Weather Service in Hastings has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Thayer County in south central Nebraska...

* Until midnight CDT.

* At 1108 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Chester, or
15 miles north of Belleville, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Hubbell around 1115 PM CDT.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Port Washington to North Point Light WI; Lake Michigan from Port Washington to North Point Light WI 5NM offshore to Mid Lake
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
For the following areas...
Nearshore waters from Port Washington WI to North Point Light WI...
Lake Michigan from Port Washington WI to North Point Light WI 5 nm
off shore to mid lake...

At 1106 PM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 17 nm east of Cleveland to 19 nm southeast of
Sheboygan to 8 nm southeast of Port Washington, moving east at 30
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

Strong thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.

SVRTOP

The National Weather Service in Topeka has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Eastern Republic County in north central Kansas...

* Until 1130 PM CDT.

* At 1106 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Chester,
moving southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Belleville, Cuba, Munden, and Narka.

events.summary:
At 1004 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 8 miles northwest of Oshkosh to near Barton.
Movement was east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Oshkosh, Big Springs, Lewellen, Barton, Ruthon, Clear Creek State
Wildlife Management Area, Intersection of Highway 27 and 9 Mile Road,
Megeath, Ash Hollow State Historical Park, Goldeneye State Wildlife
Management Area, Bluewater Battlefield State Historical Park,
Windlass Hill, and Sugar Loaf Hill.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 92 between mile markers 115 and 121.
Interstate 80 in Nebraska between mile markers 88 and 114.

events.region: Waters from Cape Mendocino to Pt. Arena CA from 10 to 60 nm
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, north winds 20 to 25 kt
with gusts up to 30 kt and seas around 9 feet. For the Gale
Watch, north winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas
9 to 11 feet possible.

* WHERE...Waters from Cape Mendocino to Pt. Arena CA from 10 to
60 nm.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 5 AM PDT Thursday.
For the Gale Watch, from 5 AM PDT Thursday through Thursday
evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
